rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Rossiyskaya Gazeta prints CEC resolution No. 112/893-6 of 7 March 2012 with its annex under 'Дата первой официальной публикации: 8 марта 2012 г.' in the federal issue No. 5724: 71,701,665 voters took part in the voting, and 'Владимира Владимировича Путина', with 45,602,075 votes (63.60 per cent), is deemed elected President of the Russian Federation.
